instruction: A candid action photograph captured from a full shot at eye-level shows a martial arts dojo with yellow walls and a red and blue mat floor. On the left, the man in the black martial arts uniform with white stripes (R1) stands in a defensive stance, facing right to block an incoming strike. On the right, the woman in the black martial arts uniform with a red belt (R2) lunges forward, throwing a right-hand punch. The man (R1) blocks the punch from the woman (R2) with his forearm. The scene is illuminated by bright overhead indoor lighting, highlighting the warm yellow walls and vibrant floor mats.
